records.title: Linear Recurrent Neural Networks as Time-Delay Embeddings
records.reason: The arXiv abstract is theoretical analysis of linear recurrent networks as time-delay embeddings for dynamical systems; no LLM inference-system contribution is presented.

records.title: When Eyes Betray AI: Social Gaze Consistency as a Semantic Cue for AI-Generated Image Detection
records.reason: The work develops social-gaze semantic cues and paired-edit data for AI-generated image detection. Its focus is image-detection accuracy and representation, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Emergence of an antiferromagnetic topological Anderson insulator in the interacting Haldane model
records.reason: The paper analyzes topological insulating phases in an interacting Haldane model using finite-size exact diagonalization. It is unrelated to language-model inference systems.

records.title: Heterogeneous Parallelism for Multimodal Large Language Model Training
records.reason: The full text explicitly presents heterogeneous parallel layouts and placement for multimodal foundation-model training and reports TFLOPS/GPU and training token throughput. This is a training-system contribution, outside the project’s inference-time scope.
